### Key Buying & Safety Considerations

- **Dosage & food comparison** : Typical label doses contain much less vitamin A, iron, and B vitamins than a 3-ounce cooked serving of liver, and taking large amounts of capsules gets expensive quickly.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RyUgEfEP1fM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-tcUE1t8zEIXyK4ntUeM-Bbu2jYamotq6mZ6TIxti7rmz1fRWNkj-Yeicsi3bbngzG7TnSBPpwh8AXXf6S_5gQHeNNUzUuRM9R79yeUaBqRDOCUnbzsNGAVxS0s4uKGonis517s39r2yTzjn648gnSfHFEobdJq03OpT14W3AqT6CDQsH-NEcg1TTA)
- **Vitamin A & mineral buildup** : Preformed vitamin A, iron, and copper are stored in the body. High intake—especially when stacked with multivitamins or other vitamin A sources—can cause toxicity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-tcUE1t8zEIXyK4ntUeM-Bbu2jYamotq6mZ6TIxti7rmz1fRWNkj-Yeicsi3bbngzG7TnSBPpwh8AXXf6S_5gQHeNNUzUuRM9R79yeUaBqRDOCUnbzsNGAVxS0s4uKGonis517s39r2yTzjn648gnSfHFEobdJq03OpT14W3AqT6CDQsH-NEcg1TTA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzcncFtP0yo&t=82)
- **Who should avoid or check with a doctor** : Pregnant individuals (high preformed vitamin A increases birth defect risk), people with liver disease, iron or copper storage disorders, or those taking retinoids or blood thinners.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1-tcUE1t8zEIXyK4ntUeM-Bbu2jYamotq6mZ6TIxti7rmz1fRWNkj-Yeicsi3bbngzG7TnSBPpwh8AXXf6S_5gQHeNNUzUuRM9R79yeUaBqRDOCUnbzsNGAVxS0s4uKGonis517s39r2yTzjn648gnSfHFEobdJq03OpT14W3AqT6CDQsH-NEcg1TTA)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzcncFtP0yo&t=82)
- **Sourcing** : Many shoppers look for 100% grass-fed, pasture-raised cattle and third-party or lab testing for quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXx0AFBHiny-ALFtI11GULY7obzeKk-60mQl0ogb50u50Gl51GMjPfhgY2W73IkV8e2-MNTn-MIL28CnOjihZy6vaCaSOazLsukE3FlvameptmnJFMdDx7xeSoRECD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXtnpSdatzrnRNxJr6Vvfp9SUqQWVpeqI6u88a3U2RrW4MfQbXnje7uh4ByHNj3s460KpUyreG0J_Y9gb7SPGgXVA5yhahfSgB-WvJ1mMoToZxoP0ZjP2cGo2CmrKALjTCiZjA7kPtBg)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JNPYPrvQEak)

To help narrow down the best option, let me know:

- Your **main goal** (such as general energy, B12/iron support, or avoiding the taste of liver)
- Any **dietary or sourcing preferences** (like 100% grass-fed, capsule count, or budget)
- Whether you take **other supplements or medications** (such as a multivitamin, iron, or blood thinners)

- **Sourcing** : Many shoppers look for 100% grass-fed, pasture-raised cattle and third-party or lab testing for quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXx0AFBHiny-ALFtI11GULY7obzeKk-60mQl0ogb50u50Gl51GMjPfhgY2W73IkV8e2-MNTn-MIL28CnOjihZy6vaCaSOazLsukE3FlvameptmnJFMdDx7xeSoRECD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXtnpSdatzrnRNxJr6Vvfp9SUqQWVpeqI6u88a3U2RrW4MfQbXnje7uh4ByHNj3s460KpUyreG0J_Y9gb7SPGgXVA5yhahfSgB-WvJ1mMoToZxoP0ZjP2cGo2CmrKALjTCiZjA7kPtBg)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JNPYPrvQEak)
